bead.title: Specify hybrid async checkpoint contract
bead.description: Update governing specs before implementation. In-scope files: docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md, docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md, docs/helix/04-build/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md, docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md. Required content: split objectlog/hybrid-strict from objectlog/hybrid-async; success barrier = object-log manifest commit plus synchronous memory apply/render; unknown-outcome semantics; request_id matrix for client mutations; ordered batching contract; async SQLite logical high-water and WAL distinction; idempotency/outcome retention; log lineage validation; retention frontier; poison/repair rules; backpressure/debt metrics; crash and perf matrix gates. Out of scope: code changes.
bead.acceptance: 1. rg -n 'hybrid-async|hybrid-strict|unknown-outcome|request_id|lineage|retention frontier|ordered batching|sqlite_high_water|backpressure' docs/helix docs/perf succeeds.\n2. cargo test -p pqueue-release ledger_path_honors_env_override_and_default passes.\n3. cargo fmt --check passes.
